params.body:
The public partner API page (https://traders.stocklistdealer.eu/docs/partner, rendered from `docs/api/partner-api.md`) shows two things that do not belong on a public page:

- The token paragraph names the framework package behind `POST /api/token` and says a grant "staat uit", which is implementation detail and jargon for an integrator.
- The section "Wie gebruikt deze API" names the partners that call the API, how often they call, and a path in this repository. That is commercial information about third parties, and it does not help anyone integrate.

Expected: the page says what each route does and nothing about who else uses it. A website builder who only wants to show cars is pointed to the public API or the embed.
params.title: Public partner API page names internal details and lists partners
